topics.title: llama.cpp b11344 — Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MTP

topics.title: Crew-13 docked + Falcon Heavy NROL-97
topics.why: Crew-13 launched Thu 10:10am CT, docked ISS 6:05pm CT in 7h55m (record U.S. to station), hatch 8:19pm CT. FH NROL-97 lifted 10:54pm CT LC-39A — NRO’s first Falcon Heavy; LZ-1/LZ-2. Transporter-18 also flew ~1:33pm CT (130 payloads). xAI quiet.
